_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Wee Mchezaji {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe ya Wachezaji Watatu.
Alamulaako ni '{symbol}'.
Mumawona kuyenda kwa kupanga alamulaako pamoja na bodi 5x5 ili kuunda mstari wa nne.
Mistari inaweza kuwa ya usawa, wima, au diagonal.
Tuma chaguo lako kwa kutumia fomu '[4]' ili kuchora seli 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kusintha kosagwira ntchito. Gwiritsani '[cell]' pamene selo ndi 0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nambala ya selo yosagwira ntchito: {cell}. Iyenera kukhala pakati pa 0 ndi {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} akuyika alamu lake ({symbol}) mu ufa ({row}, {col}).
